candidate_claim_under_test: A content-addressed representation contract and evidence-bound operational policy that chooses per query between zero-write reverse-query translation into a resident old-space index and an exactly materialized forward-translated new-space index, abstains fail-closed on identity, evidence, confidence, or materialization failure, and is evaluated once on dataset and encoder-transition families held out along both axes.

combination_result.interpretation: The exact combined system was not found in this bounded audit. vectormigrate is a particularly close systems disclosure: it combines an EmbeddingABI, directional compatibility operators, and confidence-gated routing from a transformed query against the old index to dual-read or a target index. Metric Compatible Training and Online Backfilling with No Regret also disclose paired retrieval paths and merged operation during backfill. The remaining distinction is narrow: BCC-1 compares that reverse route against a separately materialized forward-transformed legacy corpus rather than a native or conventionally backfilled target index, and binds the choice to stricter evidence and one-shot evaluation contracts. FastFill, Darwinian Model Upgrades, Amazon's issued patent, and Disney's pending application further crowd the surrounding migration and cross-space-search claims. Absence of the exact combination is not evidence of novelty, priority, patentability, or usefulness.
combination_result.required_next_search: Freeze source snapshots where licensing permits, record publication and release chronology, and perform backward and forward citation searches from every paper and first-party system below before any novelty statement.
